name: Braze
description: Braze is a customer engagement platform for cross-channel Campaigns, Canvases, audience orchestration, behavioral data, messaging, personalization, and analytics.
agentUseSummary: Enter one dedicated workspace REST API key with exactly campaigns.list, campaigns.data_series, and canvas.list plus its provisioned regional REST endpoint. Relay validates both list permissions and exposes only twenty-five content-free Campaign summaries, twenty-five content-free Canvas summaries, and a seven-day top-level aggregate series for one Campaign from that bounded page; users, audiences, identity, content, detailed reports, broader APIs, arbitrary queries, pagination, exports, and writes remain blocked.

credentialRequirements.name: BRAZE_REST_ENDPOINT
credentialRequirements.label: Braze REST endpoint
credentialRequirements.helpText: Copy the exact regional REST endpoint shown with the key in Settings > APIs and Identifiers. Relay accepts only Braze's currently documented regional hosts.

credentialRequirements.name: BRAZE_REST_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Braze REST API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Create a dedicated workspace key with exactly campaigns.list, campaigns.data_series, and canvas.list; configure Railway egress IPs at creation because Braze key permissions and IP allowlists are immutable.

capabilities.label: Campaign metadata
capabilities.description: List bounded, content-free Campaign lifecycle summaries.

capabilities.label: Canvas metadata
capabilities.description: List bounded, content-free Canvas lifecycle summaries.

capabilities.label: Campaign analytics
capabilities.description: Read one fixed seven-day Campaign aggregate series.

allowed.label: List recent campaigns
allowed.description: Read the newest unarchived Campaign page and return at most twenty-five content-free lifecycle summaries.

allowed.label: List recent Canvases
allowed.description: Read the newest unarchived Canvas page and return at most twenty-five content-free lifecycle summaries.

allowed.label: Read campaign analytics
allowed.description: Read a fixed seven-day top-level aggregate series for one Campaign proven to belong to the bounded Campaign page.

blocked.label: Access users or audiences
blocked.description: Users, identifiers, attributes, devices, events, purchases, sessions, segments, audience membership, and profile exports are outside V1.

blocked.label: Access content or detailed reports
blocked.description: Campaign/Canvas names, tags, descriptions, message variations, bodies, subjects, URLs, recipients, channel/variation drilldowns, and Currents data are outside V1.

blocked.label: Change or send Braze data
blocked.description: Tracking, identifying, merging, creating, updating, deleting, triggering, sending, scheduling, and administering Braze resources are outside V1.

blocked.label: Access broader Braze APIs
blocked.description: Catalogs, Cloud Data Ingestion, email/SMS status, templates, content blocks, preference centers, SCIM, SDK authentication, and broader export APIs are outside V1.

blocked.label: Run arbitrary requests
blocked.description: Arbitrary endpoints, paths, pages, filters, time ranges, Campaigns outside the bounded list, pagination, crawling, synchronization, exports, and raw API access are outside V1.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Three bounded metadata and aggregate reads run automatically; users, audiences, identity, content, detailed reports, broader APIs, arbitrary requests, exports, and writes stay blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same three read-only tools run while exact regional endpoint and provider permissions, fixed pages and time windows, membership checks, audit, redaction, and provider limits remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts three bounded Braze read wrappers and attaches the encrypted scoped workspace REST key and validated regional endpoint server-side.
Railway mounts three bounded Braze read wrappers and attaches the encrypted scoped workspace REST key and validated regional endpoint server-side.

providerSetup.nextAction: The customer creates a dedicated workspace REST API key with exactly campaigns.list, campaigns.data_series, and canvas.list, configures Railway egress IPs before creation if desired, copies the provisioned REST endpoint, and rotates by replacing the immutable key.

evidence.supports: Braze documents workspace REST API keys, endpoint-specific permissions, immutable permission/IP-allowlist settings, the current regional REST endpoint table, Bearer authentication, and default rate limits.

GET /campaigns/list requires campaigns.list, supports fixed page zero/newest/unarchived parameters, and returns Campaign ID, last-edited time, name, API-campaign status, and tags; Relay strips names and tags.
GET /canvas/list requires canvas.list, supports fixed page zero/newest/unarchived parameters, and returns Canvas ID, last-edited time, name, and tags; Relay strips names and tags.

GET /campaigns/data_series requires campaigns.data_series and supports a one-to-100-day range; Relay fixes seven days and returns only top-level daily aggregate fields without channel or variation drilldowns.
